verdicts.evidence: At 9222722, integration-tests ran only `yarn generate-abis` (ci.yml:239), so dist/migrations was never built. LucieFaire flagged the missing migrations, and commit 7a7c9f2 restored `yarn run build` in that job, with a comment pointing to postgres.config.ts.

`cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}` was at ci.yml:22 in 9222722. The author replied "Release concurrency — no change": the group is keyed on github.ref, so different tags cannot cancel each other. The line is unchanged.

The node_modules cache at 9222722 had no restore-keys (ci.yml:85-90 etc.). The author called the suggestion "moot" and never added restore-keys. cda62e3 removed the cache entirely, but for supply-chain reasons, not to adopt this suggestion.
The author said they were "keeping it intentionally" so the job stays self-guarding. In 7a7c9f2/cda62e3 the `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` check stays, with only an explanatory comment added.

clovisdasilvaneto asked how the cache is invalidated. PooyaRaki replied on 2026-06-15 that the `hashFiles('yarn.lock')` part of the key invalidates it whenever dependencies change, i.e. the behaviour was intended and explained.

The warm-cache install skip existed at 9222722. The author checked and replied that biome and env:validate never resolve `@/abis`, and that postinstall never runs anyway because of `enableScripts: false`. No change was made for this concern.
